name: Their Number Is Legion
oracle_text:
Create X tapped 2/2 black Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens, then you gain life equal to the number of artifacts you control. Exile Their Number Is Legion.
You may cast this card from your graveyard.
blocked_sentences: You may cast this card from your graveyard.

needs.what: the card's own unconditional permission to cast an instant or sorcery from its owner's graveyard at its printed mana cost (X included, announced as usual), with no alternative cost involved; the spell then goes wherever it normally would, which here is exile via exiles_itself
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `cast_from_graveyard` static with active_zones ["graveyard"] is exactly this permission, but the loader refuses it on any card without a permanent type ('supported on permanent cards only -- the nonpermanent form has no witness'). `graveyard_cast` + `graveyard_cost` is an alternative cost (escape-style), not a cast at the printed price, so writing graveyard_cost {X}{B}{B}{B}{B} would change how it interacts with other alternative costs and free-cast effects; `flashback`/`retrace` add exile or a discard that is not printed; `grant_graveyard_cast` is a permission granted to other spells. The rest of the card is expressible: create_token necron_warrior_2_2_b_artifact with amount {x}, tapped: true; gain_life amount {count: artifacts you control}; exiles_itself: true
